input.quote: (h) Neither Party may assign (voluntarily, by operation of law, or otherwise) this Agreement or any rights or obligations under this Agreement without the other Party's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld, provided however, that either Party may assign this Agreement without approval or consent to any affiliate or purchaser of all or substantially all of said Party's assets related to the subject matter of this Agreement or to any successor by way of merger, stock sale, consolidation or similar transaction.
input.rationale: Section (h) is a mutual assignment clause with a consent standard that is expressly "not to be unreasonably withheld," plus a consent-free carve-out allowing AP to assign to an affiliate, to a purchaser of all or substantially all of its relevant assets, or to a successor by merger, stock sale or consolidation — the core preferred protection for the Customer. A document-wide search for "change of control" returns no results, and the termination provisions contain no Kubient right to terminate or re-price on an AP change of control (only mutual insolvency/breach triggers at p0016), so no walk-away trigger is present. The only gap versus the preferred position is the absence of an express bar on Kubient assigning to an AP competitor; given the clause is otherwise symmetric and balanced (and satisfies the fallback of mutual successor assignment with a reasonableness consent standard), reopening it to make the carve-out one-sided is disproportionate. Note the Kubient License at p0002 is stated to be "non-transferable, non-assignable," but that limits sublicensing/transfer of the license grant itself rather than assignment of the Agreement, which is governed by (h).
